sentences.en: I got a tip from a new friend of mine.
sentences.tc: 我从一位新朋友那里得到了一個建议。

englishTokens.text: I got a tip from a new friend of mine.

sentences.en: She's Chinese and when she learned English, she said that she used to put sticky notes with the names in English on every object in her house.
sentences.tc: 她是中國人，當她學習英語时，她說她曾經在家里的每件物品上贴上帶有英文名称的便籤。

englishTokens.text: She's Chinese and when she learned English, she said that she used to put sticky notes with the names in English on every object in her house.

sentences.en: That way she learned the name of everything around her in English first, not unnecessary English words that you never use.
sentences.tc: 這樣，她首先學會了周围一切事物的英文名称，而不是那些你从不使用的不必要的英文單詞。

englishTokens.text: That way she learned the name of everything around her in English first, not unnecessary English words that you never use.

sentences.en: Therefore, you forget eventually with the sticky notes.
sentences.tc: 因此，你最終會忘记便利贴。

englishTokens.text: Therefore, you forget eventually with the sticky notes.

sentences.en: You see them all day.
sentences.tc: 你整天都能看到它們。

englishTokens.text: You see them all day.

sentences.en: Your brain is always thinking in English because of those sticky notes.
sentences.tc: 因為那些便利贴，你的大腦總是用英語思考。

englishTokens.text: Your brain is always thinking in English because of those sticky notes.

sentences.en: So, I'm doing the same with Chinese.
sentences.tc: 所以，我對中文也做了同樣的事情。

englishTokens.text: So, I'm doing the same with Chinese.

sentences.en: I followed my friend's advice and I wrote down every word from around my house onto a sticky note and I stuck them onto each object.
sentences.tc: 我聽从了朋友的建议，把家里的每一個字都寫在便利贴上，然後把它們贴在每個物體上。

englishTokens.text: I followed my friend's advice and I wrote down every word from around my house onto a sticky note and I stuck them onto each object.

sentences.en: My computer, my table, my plants, and even on my kitchen chair.
sentences.tc: 我的電腦、我的桌子、我的植物，甚至我的廚房椅子上。

englishTokens.text: My computer, my table, my plants, and even on my kitchen chair.

sentences.en: That's been a super useful tip.
sentences.tc: 這是一個非常有用的提示。

englishTokens.text: That's been a super useful tip.

sentences.en: I recommend you try it, too.
sentences.tc: 我建议你也嘗試一下。

englishTokens.text: I recommend you try it, too.

sentences.en: These were the essentials I bought for my home so far.
sentences.tc: 這些是迄今為止我為家里購買的必需品。

englishTokens.text: These were the essentials I bought for my home so far.

sentences.en: I still have a few things to get, but my apartment isn't fully furnished yet.
sentences.tc: 我还有一些东西要買，但我的公寓还沒有家具齐全。

englishTokens.text: I still have a few things to get, but my apartment isn't fully furnished yet.

sentences.en: What is an essential in your home?
sentences.tc: 你家里的必需品是什麼？

englishTokens.text: What is an essential in your home?

sentences.en: What's the most important thing in your house?
sentences.tc: 你家里最重要的东西是什麼？

englishTokens.text: What's the most important thing in your house?

sentences.en: Mine is the couch.
sentences.tc: 我的是沙發。

englishTokens.text: Mine is the couch.

sentences.en: It makes any space feel like a home and it lets me and my family, me and my friends -- sit down and laugh together.
sentences.tc: 它讓任何空間都像家一樣，讓我和我的家人、我和我的朋友——坐下來一起歡笑。

englishTokens.text: It makes any space
feel
like a home and it lets me and my family, me and my friends -- sit down and laugh together.

sentences.en: Don't forget to like this video if you enjoyed it, so I can focus on making more videos like these!
sentences.tc: 如果您喜歡這個視頻，請不要忘记点讚，這樣我就可以集中精力制作更多类似的視頻！

englishTokens.text: Don't forget to like this video if you enjoyed it, so I can focus on making more videos like these!

sentences.en: SUBSCRIBE and hit the notification bell to learn comprehensible English in fun, easy ways.
sentences.tc: 訂阅并按通知铃，以有趣、簡單的方式學習可理解的英語。

englishTokens.text: SUBSCRIBE and hit the notification bell to learn
comprehensible
English in fun, easy ways.

sentences.en: Never stop learning guys.
sentences.tc: 永遠不要停止學習。

englishTokens.text: Never stop learning guys.

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.tc: 再见。

englishTokens.text: Bye.

examples.en: So, join me in this __slow English podcast__!
__Something else__ that's very important, the tuppers.
In my last video, I showed you guys what I had bought __so far__, but now I've bought even more.

usages.usage: 表示理解、取得服務或變成某種狀態

examples: It's a good idea to 《have》 plants in your home if you don't already.
It makes any space 《feel》 like a home and it lets me and my family, me and my friends -- sit down and laugh together.

breakdowns.sentence: I am in my new apartment and I need to furnish it.
breakdowns.translation: 我在我的新公寓里，我需要装修它。

points.label: 不定詞片語
points.note: 表示目的、計畫或想做的事。

breakdowns.sentence: My dad says that that mirror can cause a fire...
breakdowns.translation: 我爸爸說那面镜子會引起火灾......。

breakdowns.translation: 我每晚都在看《权力的游戏》。

points.note: 表示從過去持續到現在的動作或狀態。
